questions.stem: Which is the longest river flowing entirely within India?
questions.explanation: The Godavari (~1,465 km) is the longest river that flows entirely within India, earning it the name 'Dakshin Ganga' (Ganga of the South). The Ganga is longer overall but spends part of its course in Bangladesh. The Godavari rises in Maharashtra (Trimbak, Nashik) and empties into the Bay of Bengal in Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest state of India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area (~342,239 sq km), covering about 10.4% of the country's land area. Madhya Pradesh is the second largest, followed by Maharashtra. Uttar Pradesh is the largest by POPULATION, not area.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi (7,816 m) in Uttarakhand is the highest peak located entirely within India. Kanchenjunga (8,586 m) is taller but lies on the India–Nepal border. K2 is in the Pakistan-administered region. Mount Everest is on the Nepal–China border, not in India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Jammu & Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India. Chilika (Odisha) is the largest lake overall but is a brackish-water lagoon, not freshwater. Loktak (Manipur) is famous for its floating phumdis; Dal Lake (Srinagar) is much smaller.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the smallest state of India by area?
questions.explanation: Goa is the smallest Indian state by area (~3,702 sq km). Sikkim is the second smallest. Among Union Territories, Lakshadweep is the smallest. Goa is also the state with one of the highest per-capita incomes in India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the longest national highway in India?
questions.explanation: NH 44 is the longest national highway in India (~3,745 km), running north–south from Srinagar (J&K) to Kanyakumari (Tamil Nadu). It was formed by merging several older highways. NH 27 (east–west, Gujarat to Assam) is the second longest.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest district in India by area?
questions.explanation: Leh district in Ladakh is the largest district in India by area (~45,000 sq km after reorganisation). Kutch in Gujarat is the largest district within a full-fledged STATE. Jaisalmer is the largest district in Rajasthan. These distinctions (UT vs state) are a frequent exam trap.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the highest waterfall in India?
questions.explanation: Kunchikal Falls in Karnataka (~455 m) is generally regarded as the highest waterfall in India. Jog Falls is the most famous and one of the highest plunge waterfalls. Nohkalikai (Meghalaya) is the tallest plunge waterfall. Measurement methods vary, but Kunchikal tops most official lists by total height.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest mangrove forest in India?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans in West Bengal is the largest mangrove forest in India (and the world's largest mangrove ecosystem, shared with Bangladesh). It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to the Royal Bengal Tiger. Bhitarkanika (Odisha) is the second largest mangrove area in India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the longest railway platform in India?
questions.explanation: Hubballi Junction in Karnataka has the world's longest railway platform (~1,507 m), inaugurated in 2023, overtaking Gorakhpur. Gorakhpur (UP) was the previous record holder (~1,366 m). Kharagpur and Kollam were earlier record holders. This is a frequently-updated GK fact, so note the current holder is Hubballi.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest dome in India?
questions.explanation: Gol Gumbaz in Bijapur (Vijayapura), Karnataka — the mausoleum of Mohammed Adil Shah — has the largest dome in India and one of the largest in the world. It is famous for its 'Whispering Gallery' where even faint sounds echo multiple times. The Taj Mahal's dome is iconic but smaller.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.explanation: Gujarat has the longest coastline of any Indian state (~1,600 km), owing to its extensive Saurashtra and Kutch peninsular coasts. Andhra Pradesh has the second longest, followed by Tamil Nadu. (Among all coastal regions, including islands, the figures differ, but for mainland states Gujarat leads.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest cantilever (and now highest rail) bridge-related superlative — specifically, what is the Chenab Bridge in J&K famous for?

options.text: First cable-stayed rail bridge in India

questions.explanation: The Chenab Bridge in Jammu & Kashmir is the world's highest railway arch bridge, standing ~359 m above the Chenab river (taller than the Eiffel Tower). It is part of the Udhampur–Srinagar–Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL). The Atal Tunnel is the longest highway tunnel; the Atal Setu (Mumbai) is the longest sea bridge in India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) in India by market capitalisation, often the first Indian company to cross significant market-cap milestones?
questions.explanation: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is the largest PSU by market capitalisation following its 2022 IPO — the largest IPO in Indian history at the time. It is also the largest insurance company and institutional investor in India. ONGC and IOC are large energy PSUs but smaller in market cap.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the most populous city (urban agglomeration) in India?
questions.explanation: The Mumbai (Greater Mumbai) urban agglomeration is the most populous in India per the 2011 Census. Delhi is the most populous if considering the National Capital Territory and is projected to overtake Mumbai. Note: by city municipal limits the answer can differ, but for urban agglomeration Mumbai leads per Census 2011.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest river island in the world, located in India?
questions.explanation: Majuli in Assam, on the Brahmaputra river, is the largest river island in the world and India's first island district. It is a centre of Assamese Vaishnavite culture (Satras founded by Srimanta Sankardev). Its area has been shrinking due to erosion. Srirangam (on the Kaveri) is a notable temple river island but smaller.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the highest battlefield in the world, controlled by India?
questions.explanation: The Siachen Glacier in the eastern Karakoram range is the highest battlefield in the world, with army posts above 6,000 m. India has controlled it since Operation Meghdoot (1984). Kargil (1999 war) and Galwan Valley (2020 clash) are also high-altitude conflict zones but lower than Siachen.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the longest dam in India?
questions.explanation: The Hirakud Dam on the Mahanadi river in Odisha is the longest dam in India (~26 km including its earthen flanks), and among the longest in the world. Tehri is the TALLEST dam in India. Bhakra is one of the highest gravity dams. Nagarjuna Sagar is the largest masonry dam.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the tallest statue in India (and the world)?

options.text: Veera Abhaya Anjaneya Hanuman Swami (Andhra Pradesh)

questions.explanation: The Statue of Unity in Gujarat, depicting Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, is the tallest statue in the world at 182 m, inaugurated in 2018. The Statue of Equality (Ramanuja, Hyderabad) is a notable seated statue at 216 ft. The Statue of Unity remains the global record holder.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest saltwater lake (lagoon) in India?
questions.explanation: Chilika Lake in Odisha is the largest brackish-water (saltwater) lagoon in India and the largest coastal lagoon in Asia. It is a Ramsar wetland famous for migratory birds and Irrawaddy dolphins. Sambhar (Rajasthan) is the largest INLAND saline lake. Vembanad (Kerala) is the longest lake. Pulicat is the second largest lagoon.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: A candidate must distinguish 'highest', 'tallest', and 'largest' dams. Which pairing is entirely correct?

options.text: Tallest = Tehri; Longest = Hirakud; Highest gravity dam = Bhakra
Tallest = Bhakra; Longest = Tehri; Largest = Hirakud
Tallest = Hirakud; Longest = Bhakra; Highest = Tehri
Tallest = Nagarjuna Sagar; Longest = Tehri; Highest = Hirakud

questions.explanation: Tehri Dam (Uttarakhand, ~260 m) is the tallest dam in India. Hirakud (Odisha, ~26 km) is the longest. Bhakra (~226 m) is one of the highest gravity (concrete) dams. These three superlatives are routinely mixed up in exams, so the precise pairing matters: Tehri tallest, Hirakud longest, Bhakra a high gravity dam.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the southernmost point of the Indian Union (mainland + territory)?
questions.explanation: Indira Point on Great Nicobar Island is the southernmost point of the Indian Union (territory). Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of MAINLAND India. This is a classic distinction: 'India' (including islands) ends at Indira Point; 'mainland India' ends at Kanyakumari. Indira Point was partly submerged after the 2004 tsunami.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which state in India has the largest area under forest cover (in absolute terms, sq km)?
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh has the largest forest cover in India by AREA (absolute sq km), per the India State of Forest Report. Mizoram has the highest forest cover as a PERCENTAGE of its geographical area. Arunachal Pradesh is second by area. This area-vs-percentage distinction is a common exam trap.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the largest tiger reserve in India by area?
questions.explanation: The Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve, spanning Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, is the largest tiger reserve in India by area (~3,700 sq km). Jim Corbett (1936) was the FIRST national park/tiger reserve in India. Bandipur and Sundarbans are important reserves but smaller in area.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the highest-altitude lake in India, often cited among the world's highest?
questions.explanation: Cholamu Lake (and nearby Gurudongmar Lake) in the Sikkim/North Sikkim region, at roughly 5,330 m+, ranks among the highest lakes in India and the world. Pangong Tso and Tso Moriri are famous high-altitude Ladakh lakes but slightly lower. Gurudongmar (~5,430 m) is among the highest accessible lakes. Exact rankings vary by source, but the Sikkim high lakes top the list.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
